description: PUOLOP DW01A — single-cell Li-ion/LiPo protection controller, SOT-23-6. Overcharge cut at ~4.30 V, overdischarge cut at ~2.40 V, overcurrent/short-circuit detection. Drives an external back-to-back N-channel pair (FS8205A or equivalent) to disconnect the cell on fault. The cheap-and-cheerful single-cell BMS companion to TP4056 chargers.
name: dw01a
watch_out_for: DW01A is JUST the controller — you also need a dual N-FET in SOT-23-6 (FS8205A is the standard companion) to act as the switch elements. Trip current is set by the FETs' Rds(on), NOT by the DW01A. Auto-recovery from overdischarge happens only after the load is removed and the cell rebounds above ~3.0 V — many cheap LiPo packs feel 'dead' but recover after a few minutes off-load. Keep gate traces short between DW01A pins 3/5 and the FET gates.
